description.value:
Your version of Overflow itself, made literal: a low-grade effect that's always on, whether you're drawing more or not. Everything the Singularity destroys, something else escapes outward at the exact same moment — you're just close enough to catch a little of what gets out.

THE LEAK — a passive, always-on drip of void damage to one enemy in range at the start of each of your turns — no action, no save, and no Overflow drawn to trigger it.

cinderfall.incomplete: This Aspect base feat plausibly wants a GrantItem granting its signature focus spell/ability, matching the ChoiceSet+GrantItem pattern already used for the Aspect subclass choice itself (reckoner.aspect.json). Not shipped: the only intra-corpus GrantItem precedents are a dynamic ChoiceSet-selection token or a fixed UUID into the real pf2e system's own compendiums -- there is no existing example of a fixed GrantItem pointing at another Cinderfall-authored card by literal compendium UUID, and the Cinderfall Foundry module's actual pack/document naming (tools/foundry/build_pack.py / pf2e-cinderfall-module) was not checked in this cards-only research pass. See feats-class-reckoner-draft.md open question 1 (GRANTITEM-UUID-OPEN). Separately: this card's own signature ability, THE LEAK (a passive always-on drip to a player-chosen enemy each turn), has no separate card in this corpus and is itself unbuildable -- same reasoning as Faint Leak, no selector exists for player-directed, per-turn, no-action single-target damage.
